thread:
sales_engineer_ash: Hey infra team — OmniRetail POC needs a dedicated pool. Requesting 2x H100 (80GB) in us-east4, isolated tenant, VPC peering to their AWS VPC. Target start week of 2026-04-06. Can we get an ETA and any blockers? :wave:
account_exec_ravi: Budget note — customer committed ~$20k/mo for the POC. They also want a hosted API key to run baseline while pool is being stood up.
infra_oncall_jordan: Need org/project IDs, expected QPS and token counts, and network contact for peering. H100 availability in us-east4 could be tight; we can propose 1xH100 + 1xA100 fallback.
customer_cto_emily: Estimating 40 qps peak, ~12 qps avg. Average 4k tokens per call. P95 latency target <=250ms for short prompts. Network contact is netops@omni.com.
sales_engineer_ash: Token distribution noted. They want customer-managed KMS for encrypted volumes and VPC peering. Also need private console access from their office IPs.
solutions_engineer_maya: For Llama-2-70b-ish workload, 2x H100 should achieve 40 qps with batching and KV cache. If provisioning delays, a mixed H100/A100 config is workable if we quantize.
infra_oncall_jordan: Ok. Please provide: org id, AWS CIDR for peering, KMS ARN, and a business justification + owner. Lead time is ~5 business days for H100; fallback A100 may be 2-3 days.
account_exec_ravi: Org ID: org-omni-5543. AWS CIDR: 10.12.0.0/16. Network contact: netops@omni.com (cc'd). Business owner is @customer_cto_emily. We accept fallback plan if it shortens ETA.
provisioning_bot: ticket #PROV-4821 created: dedicated-pool-omni-retail. SLA target: 5 business days. Owner: @infra_oncall_jordan.
infra_oncall_jordan: Also need allowed management IP ranges for console. Default suggestion: 54.213.45.0/24. And KMS key ARN if customer wants CMK.
customer_cto_emily: KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh. Please enable automatic rotation. Management portal IPs will include the suggested range plus our office: 203.0.113.24/29.
sales_engineer_ash: For the hosted API key: @solutions_engineer_maya can you issue a scoped key we can use during provisioning? Limit to 50 qps and logging enabled.
solutions_engineer_maya: Yep — will generate a short-lived hosted key (30d), rate-limited to 50 qps, with audit logging. I won't paste key here; will share via secure channel when ready.
infra_oncall_jordan: Starting allocation request. I'll try primary H100 + A100 fallback. Kicking off network setup — need the AWS account ID for peering and a point-of-contact for routing changes.
account_exec_ravi: AWS account id: 123456789012. POC contact for routing: netops@omni.com (says they'll coordinate). Billing start: we can start billing when pool is in "ready" state.
infra_oncall_jordan: Creating Terraform peering template for the network team to review. Example snippet for their netops to adapt:
```
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "omni_peering" {
  customer_aws_account_id = "123456789012"
  customer_cidr_block = "10.12.0.0/16"
  redwood_region = "us-east4"
  allow_management_console = true
}
```
provisioning_bot: PROV-4821 status: in-progress. Initial H100 allocation started in staging. ETA: 4 business days.
solutions_engineer_maya: Plan for a canary test once ready: 1k short prompts (100–200 tokens) at low concurrency to validate latency and KV cache behavior. I'll prepare the prompts and eval harness.
infra_oncall_jordan: Good. No blockers from infra so far. Will update ticket with ETA and provisioning logs. If H100 availability changes, I'll switch to mixed-sku and notify everyone.
account_exec_ravi: Sounds good. Keeping customer looped — @customer_cto_emily we'll message you as soon as the portal and key are available. Thanks all :thumbsup:
